$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Service landing

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: The front page of a service that offers a catalogue. It lets a person find an item by search, by category or by theme.
useFor: A service that sells a catalogue with several categories, when the person arrives from Home services, the Market tab or a deep link without an item in mind, and needs search, categories and curated rows on one page.
notFor: A service with one item or one flow (start at item details or the first step of that flow); a person who already picked a category or typed a query (use Market category or Search results); a person in a sacred window, where the service is suppressed and this page is never linked from a ritual screen; content that is not for sale, such as articles or guides, which belong to a content landing.

allowed: Toolbar · Landings / Search, over Header Effect · Stage 1.
The search placeholder names what can be searched; search lives here only.
forbidden: A second search entry or extra toolbar actions.

allowed: Notification Slots · Collapsed Off, or the upcoming-requests pattern when it carries the person’s own request state.
States one fact and offers one action.
forbidden: With nothing to say, the slot collapses and leaves no gap; it is never left empty with a gap.

allowed: The leaderboard or cards-slider pattern, shown as Media Cards · ADS, 343 × 364, scrolls sideways.
Curated collections or real campaigns; a campaign that ends states its date in words.
forbidden: A timer on a campaign end date.
The اختيارات نسك curation mark used for anything Nusuk does not actually curate.

allowed: The categories pattern, shown as Categories · Status On, 386 wide.
Every top-level category in a stable sequence, named in 1 or 2 words; the chevron expands the grid in place.
forbidden: Prices or counts on the tiles.
A sequence that changes between visits.

allowed: A local row card (radius 18) with a Secondary XS icon-only control, then the cards-slider pattern of MediaCard, 170 × 248.
One theme per row named in 2 or 3 words, 3 to 8 items, one card variant per row, and a More card at the end; the arrow opens the full collection.
forbidden: Two rows of the same item type back to back (M9P rule 6) unless an exception is recorded.

allowed: One promotional block, after the item rows.
forbidden: A position above the item rows or the categories.

allowed: SectionTitle with 2 or 3 informative cards (delivery threshold, delivery days, returns) from the service configuration.
forbidden: A %s placeholder typed into the design.
A claim the service cannot keep.

allowed: Fixed to the bottom; the cart pill shows the total and the item count.
Content keeps 170 of bottom padding so the last card clears the bar.
forbidden: The older Tab Bar together with BottomNav.

rules: No countdowns, no "limited time", no "before stock runs out"; a real end date is written as a date (M4).
A discount shows the old price and the real reduction.
اختيارات نسك marks curation and nothing else; a paid placement is labelled as an ad.
Nothing is added to the cart for the person, and nothing is pre-selected.
Row titles name an occasion or a need in 2 or 3 words, with no emoji; the row arrow answers a 48 target even though it is drawn at 50 × 30.
Item photos carry the item name as alt text; a sideways row announces its position (2 of 6) and gives a way to the full list without swiping.

allocation.App level: L2 · a service page. Reached from Home services, the Market tab and deep links.
allocation.Allocation: DNA Supportive · tier T3 · resting placement P2 · render band 6.
allocation.Suppression: suppress: sacred. The page and its entry points are hidden while the person is in a sacred window.
allocation.Withheld: Pay controls are withheld (P0) for Dependents and Organised groups; browsing stays open.

measure.success: Share of sessions that reach an item page, time to the first item view, completed requests per weekly active user
measure.guardrails: notification opt-out, complaints per 1,000 requests, refunds marked not as described

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.

example.inTheFlowToday: The notification slot in the flow reads "⚡️ أكمل الطلب قبل نفاذ المخزون" with the chip "لديك منتجات في السلة 🛍️": urgency wording and an emoji: this template shows the neutral library default instead. The ADS cards in the flow carry "لفترة محدودة", a running countdown and "وفّر 30%"; left out here pending a decision. The product row header is a local frame repeated in every row, proposed as a DL pattern (product-row). Media Cards · ADS and Categories live in 🛍️ Market and are not DL cards yet; Categories shares its name with the DL categories row. The flow uses Tab Bar while the DL now has BottomNav; one has to be chosen. Chips in the flow use Ping AR + LT at 10 px and prices use Saans TRIAL; product type is meant to be IBM Plex Sans Arabic at 12 px or more. The section header ships with placeholder content in its left slot, emptied here.
